projects.title: Elder's Veil
projects.shortSummary: A comic-reading platform with rich reading experience, curated collections, and user authentication.
projects.problem: Existing comic platforms have cluttered, advertisement-heavy interfaces that interrupt the reading experience. Readers want a clean, immersive platform that respects the art.
projects.solution: Built a clean, focused comic-reading web app with smooth page navigation, category browsing, and a distraction-free reader mode.
features: Responsive design for phone and desktop reading

projects.title: ECE × Dev Portfolio
projects.shortSummary: This very portfolio — a cinematic, JSON-driven personal website bridging electronics engineering and software development.
projects.problem: Generic portfolio templates fail to communicate the dual nature of an ECE student who builds software — they either look too engineering-focused or too design-focused.
projects.solution: Designed a custom portfolio with a visual language that transitions from electronic circuit traces to software code, communicating both identities as one coherent technical mind.
features: Cinematic intro sequence with circuit-to-code animation
JSON-driven content — edit data without touching code
Full dark/light theme system with persistence
Dual-identity section for ECE and software
Fully responsive across all screen sizes
Deployed on Vercel with zero backend

projects.title: 4-bit ALU in Verilog
projects.shortSummary: A 4-bit Arithmetic Logic Unit designed in Verilog HDL with support for addition, subtraction, AND, OR, XOR, and comparison operations.
projects.problem: Understanding how CPUs process data at the hardware level requires building the fundamental computation unit from scratch.
projects.solution: Implemented a fully functional 4-bit ALU in Verilog with a comprehensive testbench, simulating all supported operations and verifying correct output and carry/zero flags.
features: Supports ADD, SUB, AND, OR, XOR, and comparison operations
